title: Wells Fargo Advisors - Corporate Support of the Arts
description: 2011 St. Louis Arts Awards   Wells Fargo has emerged as one of our region's leading arts patrons, contributing millions of dollars to culturally enhance the St. Louis region. In 2009 and 2010, Wells Fargo sponsored the current seasons of the Saint Louis Symphony Orchestra and Opera Theatre of Saint Louis. In 2009 alone, Wells Fargo Advisors and its employees invested more than $5 million in over 90 St. Louis area non-profits including the Arts and Education Council, Grand Center, the United Way, and the Susan G. Komen Foundation.

asr.full_text: Wells Fargo Advisors is an incredibly important institution in this community not only for arts organizations, but for the entire economic development strategy of the St. Louis community. Their officers and employees are involved in many arts organizations. Community involvement is really one of the things that defines Wells Fargo Advisors. Being an active and involved member of the community is more than a responsibility. It's part of our makeup, it's part of our DNA if you will. I think it helps the organizations in St. Louis to have the senior and the junior executives involved. But it also I think helps Wells Fargo Advisors. It really helps them I think to retain really key quality people that will be the future of their organization as well as the future of the St. Louis community. Also our business, our profession, if you will, is to help people and families create a brighter future for themselves. In a sense, the volunteer work that we do and the funding we provide for the arts and for civic and charitable organizations does exactly the same thing for the community as a whole. It enriches the very fabric of the community and makes it a better place for everyone. Wells Fargo Advisors has been a strong supporter of Saint Louis Artworks for the last two years. St. Louis Artworks is a job training program in the arts for teenagers from st. Louis. They received training as apprentices to professional artists, and are hired as paid interns. A vibrant arts community and strong educational system attracts diverse high-quality talent to the region. People with new and fresh ideas and perspectives who play a role in our community and help our company strive today and in the future. Wells Fargo Advisory supports and has partnerships with so many truly outstanding art organizations Opera Theatre St. Louis, Arts & Education Council, the St. Louis Symphony, St. Louis, Arts and Education Council St. Louis Symphony, St. Louis Art Museum COCA, Shakespeare Festival, the Muni, St. Louis Repertory Theater Contemporary Art Museum, the Sheldon concert hall, Jazz St. Louis, St. Louis Art Works and the grand center Without support from people like Wells Fargo advisors ArtWorks would not be able to complete the mission that we do. We would not be able to give the kids the physical literacy training that Wells Fargo provides for our kids in our life skills development. The arts are a fundamental aspect of a community's health, so Wells Fargo is and always will be committed to supporting the arts. We have a legacy of support for the arts that goes back generations and that's going to continue for generations to come. .
